title: Ovulation induction
what: The doctor prescribes pills or injections to help an egg mature. Ultrasound is used to watch the follicle grow.
why: When you do not ovulate on your own or ovulate rarely, and you are planning a pregnancy.
duration: usually one attempt is one cycle; ultrasounds of 10 to 20 minutes several times
tell_doctor: Results of past tests and attempts
All your medicines. Do not stop them on your own
If your partner has had a semen analysis

prepare.title: Cycle
prepare.text: Treatment starts on a certain day of your cycle. The doctor will tell you when to come.

prepare.title: Medicines
prepare.text: Take them exactly as scheduled, at the same time each day.

prepare.title: Calendar
prepare.text: Put your ultrasound dates and medicine times in your calendar.

steps: At the start of the cycle, the doctor does an ultrasound
After a few days, you come back for an ultrasound
The doctor checks how many follicles there are and how big
When a follicle is mature, the doctor may prescribe a shot to trigger ovulation
The doctor tells you which days to plan sex or a procedure
feel: An internal ultrasound is a little unpleasant but does not hurt
Sometimes there is bloating or pulling pain low in the belly
after: Follow the doctor's instructions day by day
Take a pregnancy test when your doctor says
If it does not work, the treatment may be repeated
red_flags: Severe belly pain, bloating, or shortness of breath: call emergency services
Sudden weight gain over 1 to 2 days, or little urine

faq.q: How many times can ovulation induction be done?
faq.a: Usually a limited number of cycles in a row. Your doctor will decide how many.
The chance of twins is higher. That is why the doctor watches the ultrasounds closely.

reminders.text: Ultrasound for your ovulation treatment tomorrow. Take your medicines as scheduled and write down your questions.
